cases.name: large_wide_queries
cases.code:
import random
rnd = random.Random(0)
data = [rnd.randint(0, 30000) for _ in range(150000)]
qs = []
for _ in range(60000):
    l = rnd.randint(0, 100000)
    qs.append((l, min(150000, l + rnd.randint(20000, 80000))))
res = sol.recurring_counts(data, qs)
result = [len(res), sum(res), min(res), max(res), res[0], res[-1], sum(res[::997])]
